messages:
olivia: Quick sync — Vega Health renewal prep. Need a sanity check on our uptime/latency reporting for their onboarding cohort and to estimate any credit exposure. Renewal call Tuesday, want a customer-facing doc by EOD Monday.

maria-liu: Copy. Which measurement window are we showing — calendar month or rolling 30d? That affects credit calc.

kevin: For previous reports we used calendar month aligned to the contract month. Rolling 30d is used internally for alerts. I can run both if needed.

samir: FYI, our prometheus-derived uptime uses the 5xx rate + deploy fallbacks; latency SLO is p50/p95 across production prod-inference route. There's a known caveat: prefix cache warmups skew p95 during onboarding bursts.

olivia: Vega's onboarding traffic ramped mid-month so p95 looks spiky. If we show calendar month, they might ask for credits. Want to be proactive.

kevin: I can run the SQL and attach raw numbers. Quick query (run in analytics):
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day,
  1 - SUM(errors)::float / SUM(requests) as uptime,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p95
FROM prod_inference
WHERE customer_id = 'vega_health' AND ts >= '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```
Run that and export CSV.

maria-liu: Perfect. Can you also slice by model route (chat vs embed) — Vega uses both, and SLA in contract only covers chat route.

kevin: Good catch. I'll split by route. Expect CSV + summary numbers in ~90m.

samir: For credit calc: contract says uptime SLO 99.5% monthly with pro rata credits when below thresholds. We should compute monthly aggregate uptime per contract month, then apply credit table. Also note we have a clause excluding downtime from scheduled maintenance windows flagged in our system.

olivia: Do we have those maintenance windows flagged for Feb? I recall a minor infra patch on Feb 18 that might be excluded.

kevin: Patch on Feb 18 was <5m and marked, should be excluded. I'll double-check logs.

maria-liu: Once we have numbers, I'll draft the customer-facing one-pager: brief summary, uptime % by route, p95 latency, whether credit applies, and proposed remediation timeline. Want to keep tone neutral, offer root cause if credit applies.

olivia: Also capture onboarding enablement items — Vega asked for best-practice prompt templates and key monitoring dashboards. Could include a short checklist to reduce renewal risk.

samir: I can export the dashboard links and add a short blurb about cache warmups and recommended steady-state traffic shaping.

kevin: Uploading CSV to #cs-exports now and will paste summary in thread once done.

slo-bot: [incident summary] 2026-02-12 03:14 UTC — transient region outage, affected 0.06% of requests across customers, automatically remediated.

maria-liu: Action items: 1) kevin — run calendar-month and rolling-30d numbers + split by route (owner: kevin, due: +90m). 2) samir — collect maintenance exclusions + dashboard blurb (owner: samir, due: EOD). 3) maria-liu — draft one-pager with credit calc template (owner: maria-liu, due: EOD Monday). 4) olivia — final review before customer send (owner: olivia, due: Monday 12:00pm PT).

olivia: Thanks team. If credit exposure looks material (>0.5% uptime delta) we'll prep proposed credit figure and mitigation notes. Ping me when the CSV is up and I'll slot time to review. :thumbsup:
